text:
Assistant A gives a structured, actionable set of techniques: active listening, "I" statements, identifying underlying needs, compromise, and follow-up. It includes concrete example phrases and covers the whole process from understanding to resolution. It also invites the user to share more specifics.

Assistant B gives brief, generic advice: talk honestly, reflect on your own contribution, focus on the present and future, and consider professional help. The suggestion of professional help is useful, but the response has little depth and few concrete techniques.

The user asked for effective communication techniques and strategies for understanding each other's perspectives. Assistant A addresses this much better.

[[A]]
